info.title: GovCon Request for Equitable Adjustment (REA), Constructive Change & CDA Claim API
info.description: Analyzes post-award scope creep, government Furnished Equipment (GFE) delays, defective specifications, or stop-work orders under FAR 52.243-1/2/3/4, FAR 52.242-14/15/17, and the Contract Disputes Act (41 U.S.C. 7101-7109) to generate a legally structured Request for Equitable Adjustment (REA) with DCAA-auditable quantum cost tables, Eichleay unabsorbed home-office overhead analysis,FAR 31.205-33 billable preparation cost segregation, and SF-30 bilateral modification text.

post.summary: Generate a FAR 52.243 Request for Equitable Adjustment (REA), Constructive Change Analysis & CDA Claim Package

contract_change_and_delay_facts.description: Unstructured contract number, type (FFP/CPFF/T&M), COR/CO emails, technical directions, GFE delays, stop-work notices, and labor/ODC hours impacted.
contract_change_and_delay_facts.example: CONTRACT: FA8726-25-C-0089 (USAF Tactical Zero-Trust Cloud Migration, FFP + T&M CLINs, $14.2M Ceiling). EVENT 1 (GFE DELAY): Government failed to deliver 12 Accredited Cross-Domain Guard appliances by Nov 1, 2025 per Section H.8; actual delivery occurred Jan 14, 2026 (74-day delay), forcing 6 cleared engineers into standby/re-sequencing (1,480 direct labor hours). EVENT 2 (CONSTRUCTIVE CHANGE): COR directed out-of-scope legacy mainframe COBOL feed integration (2,120 engineering hours).

remedy_clause_and_submission_type.description: Target FAR entitlement clause and REA vs. Certified CDA Claim posture.

quantum_pricing_methodology.description: Contractor indirect wrap rates (Fringe, Overhead, G&A) and profit/Eichleay assumptions.
